newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan stocks fall not in line with economy - banker.
newsitem.headline: Japan stocks fall not in line with economy - banker.

text.p: Falls in Tokyo share prices are not in line with economic fundamentals, Shunsaku Hashimoto, chairman of the Federation of Bankers' Associations of Japan, told a news conference on Tuesday.
Hashimoto said it was difficult to find an explanation for the recent weakness in stock prices, taking into account present economic fundamentals.
He also said he was concerned the recent falls in stock prices might damage corporate sentiment.
"I'm worried that it may depress the economy, coupled with a worsening of corporate sentiment," Hashimoto said.
He added that the implementation of financial structural reforms was important to bring about a recovery in stocks.
The chairman said it was also necessary to carry out the "Big Bang" reform of Tokyo's financial markets earlier than the government's target of 2001.
Hashimoto added that conditions were now set to go ahead with connecting the on-line network of member banks to a network run by the securities industry.
